question: How many orders did Olist receive in 2017 (by purchase date)? How many of them were delivered? What was the total revenue of the delivered ones?
response:
Olist received 45,101 orders in 2017 by purchase date. Of those, 43,428 were delivered. Those delivered orders brought in 5,962,902.01 in revenue.

Revenue is the sum of item price on delivered orders. Freight is excluded. It is gross, with no refunds or costs.

The data has no orders before 2017-01-05, so early January is thin. Early 2017 also reflects the marketplace ramp-up.

```json
{
  "status": "answered",
  "assumptions": [
    "Year 2017 is defined by order_purchase_timestamp, 2017-01-01 to 2017-12-31 (first order in data is 2017-01-05)",
    "orders_cnt counts all orders placed, whatever their status",
    "Delivered means order_status = 'delivered'",
    "Revenue is the sum of item price (excluding freight) on delivered orders; gross, no refunds"
  ],
  "answer": {
    "orders_cnt": 45101,
    "delivered_orders_cnt": 43428,
    "total_revenue": 5962902.01
  }
}
```

question: How many orders did Olist receive in 2017 (by purchase date)? How many of them were delivered? What was the total revenue of the delivered ones?

Olist received 45,101 orders in 2017 by purchase date. Of those, 43,428 were delivered. Those delivered orders brought in 5,962,902.01 in revenue. November was the busiest month of 2017.
